dataset.name: French primary Ewing sarcoma (ICGC BOCA-FR)
dataset.description: Independent French Ewing sarcoma cohort with open ICGC Release 28 bulk RNA-seq and linked overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Primary Ewing sarcomas collected by the French ICGC bone-cancer project. All retained profiles are linked to primary solid tumors explicitly annotated as Ewing sarcoma.

metadata.redistribution_note: The open cohort is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, while direct matrix download remains disabled pending a dedicated ICGC redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: TRACE Explorer requires an endpoint-complete donor and an open Ensembl/Cufflinks RNA-seq analysis linked to a primary solid tumor explicitly annotated as Ewing sarcoma. One analysis is selected deterministically per donor.

source.required_normalization_algorithm: Cufflinks 2.2.1 http://cole-trapnell-lab.github.io/cufflinks/ cufflinks -q  --library-type fr-firststrand --max-frag-multihits 5 --min-frags-per-transfrag 5 -u -b GENOME_FASTA -G REF_GTF -o OUTDIRS SAMPLE.bam

expression.label: log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Ambiguous symbols mapped from more than one Ensembl gene are removed before the matrix is written.
expression.scale_note: ICGC supplies non-negative normalized_read_count values from Cufflinks 2.2.1. They are interpreted as the Cufflinks FPKM output, mapped through the pinned GRCh37 reference and transformed once as log2(value + 1).
